cohort: The study included pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus, women with excessive gestational weight gain, and healthy pregnant women as a control group.
finding: Serum DPP-4 concentrations were significantly higher in patients with GDM and EGWG compared to healthy women, while urinary DPP-4 concentrations were significantly higher in the control and GDM groups than in the EGWG group.
mod_finding: Women with excessive gestational weight gain have a higher risk of requiring caesarian delivery.
cross-section timing: Samples were collected on the day of delivery (for DPP-4 levels) and on the second day of the postpartum period (for body composition analysis).
